items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I think Dr. Sushon took some pictures of the house.

That's right. That's right. We lived in there many a year. He was a basement. We lived in there for many a many years. And that's where I had my rehearsals. Yeah. It's such a fine place. Beautiful basement, you know. Beautiful. See? I had my rehearsals. Everything that I had in there. I was right on then till War I. That's all.
